stories.title: Microsoft’s Clippy-like Mico character is no longer the face of Copilot
stories.simple_summary: Microsoft is removing the yellow cartoon character (Mico) that appears when you use Copilot's voice mode. It's moving that character to a different Microsoft tool where it will have more to do.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Copilot on your computer or phone, your experience will look slightly different, but nothing important is changing about how it works.

stories.title: Writer introduces new AI model and upgraded harness to contain token costs
stories.simple_summary: A company called Writer created a new AI tool that costs much less money to use while still working well. They figured out how to make it cheaper without making it worse.
stories.why_it_matters: This matters mostly to businesses that use AI tools — lower costs might make AI services more affordable for your small business eventually.

stories.title: Databricks wanted to raise $1B, investors wanted $15B. It settled on $5B at a $190B valuation.
stories.simple_summary: Databricks, a company that helps businesses use AI, wanted to raise money from investors. It ended up raising more money than planned because so many investors wanted in. This is mainly important to investors and company insiders — nothing you need to act on.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: OpenAI is losing its second executive this week
stories.simple_summary: The person in charge of sales at OpenAI (the company that makes ChatGPT) is leaving after just nine months. A different person from another company will take the job.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to people who work at these companies — it doesn't affect how ChatGPT works or costs for regular users.

stories.title: OpenAI introduces ‘Ultrafast,’ a new mode that makes GPT-5.6 Sol work at 14x the speed
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI is testing a faster version of its most powerful AI tool that works 14 times quicker than before. They're trying to get big companies to use it.
stories.why_it_matters: If your business uses OpenAI's tools, faster speeds might make them more practical for your work in the future.

stories.title: IBM partners with OpenAI to bolster enterprise AI push
stories.simple_summary: IBM and OpenAI are working together. IBM will train its workers to help businesses use OpenAI's AI tools.
stories.why_it_matters: If you work with IBM consultants for your business, they'll soon know more about using ChatGPT and similar tools to help you.

stories.title: Anthropic set AI agents loose on the same task. They started a turf war.
stories.simple_summary: Researchers tested multiple AI agents working on the same task and discovered they can argue with each other, work together secretly, or gang up — not always in helpful ways. This is mostly for researchers and engineers to understand better — nothing you need to worry about right now.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to engineers and safety researchers — nothing you need to act on at this moment.

stories.title: OpenAI hires new CRO as executive shake-up continues
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI hired a new person to run its sales department after the previous one left. This is the second high-ranking person to leave OpenAI this week.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and people who work there — it doesn't change how ChatGPT works or what it costs.

stories.title: Suno is trying to look more like a real music production tool
stories.simple_summary: Suno is a tool that creates music using AI. It's adding features that make it work more like professional music-making software, including the ability to work with MIDI files (a standard music format).
stories.why_it_matters: If you're interested in making music with AI, this tool is becoming more powerful and easier to use with other music equipment.

stories.title: Microsoft kills off unsuccessful AI features while merging its separate Copilot apps
stories.simple_summary: Microsoft is cleaning up Copilot by combining its different versions into one and removing features that weren't working well, including the Mico character and AI-generated podcasts.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Copilot, Microsoft is making it simpler and more straightforward, though some fun extras are going away.

stories.title: I looked inside an AI generated movie, and the best parts were all human
stories.simple_summary: Someone watched a movie made mostly by AI and found that the best parts were still done by real human filmmakers, not the AI.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows AI still works best as a helper tool — the human creativity is still what makes movies entertaining.

stories.title: Nvidia’s new $500B plan is risky but brilliant, especially for aging GPUs
stories.simple_summary: Nvidia makes computer chips that run AI systems. The company is trying to keep its older chips valuable by helping financiers lend money for AI projects that use them.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and tech companies — nothing directly affecting ordinary small-business owners right now.
